Alternative Text: Providing alternative text for images and non-text elements to improve compatibility with screen readers. Color Contrast: Maintaining high-contrast color schemes to enhance readability for users with visual impairments. Responsive Design: Adopting responsive design principles to ensure our website is accessible across a wide range of devices and screen sizes. Semantic Structure and ARIA: Applying ARIA roles (Accessible Rich Internet Applications) to enhance the clarity and usability of dynamic content and interactive components. Video Accessibility: Incorporating video accessibility features, such as captions or transcripts, to support users with hearing impairments. Clear Error Feedback: Implementing clear error feedback mechanisms to ensure forms and interactive elements are user-friendly and easy to understand. Regular Audits: Regularly auditing our website using industry-leading accessibility tools like WAVE, Axe, and Lighthouse to identify and address any potential barriers. Operating Systems : We aim to support various popular operating systems (such as Windows, iOS, and Android) and major browsers (including Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge) to ensure the best possible experience for all users.
